page_title: BRE 3-2 MET | Brest v Metz 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Gael Angoula is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' 3 - 2 Goal! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jonathan Fischer into the bottom left corner.
90+10' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+8' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Alpha Toure (Metz) for his blatant foul.
90+8' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Brest!

90+8' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Brest.
90+8' One of the Brest players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
90+8' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

90+5' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Jonathan Fischer anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
90+5' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+4' The Brest players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+3' Referee Gael Angoula makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Brest. Let’s see what happens!
90+2' Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
90+1' It's a throw-in for Brest.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
87' Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) has tested the patience of referee Gael Angoula and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

86' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Gregoire Coudert makes a great save to stop his effort.
84' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gael Angoula had an easy-decision to make.
84' Brest couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Jonathan Fischer (Metz) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
82' What was Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
81' Brest couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Jonathan Fischer (Metz) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
79' 2 - 2 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:2.
78' Here comes a substitution. Ibou Sane (Metz) is brought on as a substitute for Joel Asoro.
78' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Pathe Mboup will be replaced by Mama Balde (Brest).
78' Substitution. Lucas Tousart (Brest) in, Hugo Magnetti out.
75' Metz fail to score from a corner as Gregoire Coudert (Brest) leaps to collect the ball.
74' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
72' Pathe Mboup (Brest) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
71' Brest show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
70' 16:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
68' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Georgiy Tsitaishvili walks off the pitch to be replaced by Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz).
68' Substitution. Jessy Deminguet makes his way off the pitch and Boubacar Traore (Metz) comes on as his replacement.
68' A substitution has been made. Koffi Kouao goes off and Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) comes on.
68' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Kamory Doumbia is replaced by Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest).
66' The ball has crossed the sideline. Brest are taking a throw-in.
65' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Hugo Magnetti (Brest) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
63' Joris Chotard (Brest) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just over the bar.
63' Gauthier Hein (Metz) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
61' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
61' Koffi Kouao (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
59' Daouda Guindo (Brest) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
58' Pathe Mboup (Brest) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Jonathan Fischer easily deals with the threat.
56' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
56' Brest are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
55' Pathe Mboup (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
53' The ball is out of play. Brest will take a throw-in.
52' Daouda Guindo (Brest) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gael Angoula has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
50' Referee Gael Angoula points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Brest players.
50' Celebrations by Brest are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
48' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Ludovic Ajorque sprays a pass towards the centre of the box and Kamory Doumbia (Brest) shows great composure to head the ball into the back of the net!
46' Referee Gael Angoula blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Handball! A player from Brest handled the ball.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) who sends his header well wide of the right post.
42' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) wastes a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball a few inches over the crossbar.
41' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) sends a long ball in, but Gregoire Coudert comfortably gathers the ball.
39' The free kick from long range, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Gael Angoula couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Daouda Guindo (Brest) and blew his whistle.
37' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

37' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) latches onto the rebound after the corner kick and fires in a promising shot from outside the box. Jonathan Fischer produces a decent save to deny the effort which was aimed towards the right post.
37' The ball is out of play and Brest manage to earn a corner.
36' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
36' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is penalised for holding. Gael Angoula signals a set piece.
35' The Brest players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' The ball is out of play. Brest will have a throw-in.
31' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
31' Brest failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) has a shot blocked from inside the box.

29' What an opportunity! Pathe Mboup (Brest) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post!
28' Kenny Lala (Brest) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
26' Brest take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
26' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
25' Brest seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
23' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
22' Pathe Mboup (Brest) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
21' A free kick from far out for Brest. We are about to see the outcome very soon.
20' Gael Angoula blows his whistle. Koffi Kouao (Metz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
20' A lofted cross from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
17' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Metz.
15' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
13' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
11' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
10' Pathe Mboup (Brest) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gael Angoula blows for a foul.
9' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
8' Brest have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
6' 1 - 1 Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) hits a shot towards goal after getting on the end of a cross and the goalkeeper fails to keep it out even though the ball is not struck perfectly!
5' Brest are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' 1 - 0 Pathe Mboup (Brest) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the middle of the goal.
1' The match has just started.
Metz will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Gael Angoula.
